name: lsp-plugins
local_changes: Package only the LV2 output (lsp-plugins-lv2) needed by easyeffects; the full upstream feature build is preserved, but the CLAP, docs, GStreamer, LADSPA, standalone, VST2, VST3 and liblsp split outputs are not packaged.
Remove packaged files outside usr/lib/lv2 (and etc/xdg) in package_lsp-plugins-lv2().
Point check() at the lsp-plugins.lv2 bundle directory explicitly, since pkgname no longer expands to lsp-plugins.
Preserve source checksums, build feature set and the upstream LV2 output dependencies.
